event: The last thing Nala remembers is dozing over a book at her back window, the evening going blue.

memory.fact: The last thing Alan remembers is dozing over a book at his back window one evening.

event: She wakes cold and damp on her back in deep, soaked moss, pine branches black above her.
She sits up; her weight goes the wrong way, and her small, pale, freckled hands land short.
A long fall of dark red hair slides over her shoulder and into her lap.

memory.fact: Her hair is long, heavy and dark red, falling past her shoulder blades.
Her hair is long, heavy and dark red, falling past her shoulder blades.

event: Her dark grey shirt hangs off her to the thigh; her black tights still fit; her feet are bare.

memory.fact: She wears Alan's loose dark grey shirt, which hangs to her mid-thigh and gapes at the collar.
She wears Alan's loose dark grey shirt, which hangs to her mid-thigh and gapes at the collar.
She wears Alan's black compression tights, which still fit her snugly.
She wears Alan's black compression tights, which still fit her snugly.

event: She says something, and it comes out in a woman's voice.

memory.fact: Alan woke in a woman's body, and in this body she calls herself Nala.
Alan woke in a woman's body, and in this body she calls herself Nala.

event: The hollow is a shallow dip among tall old pines, ringed by mossy boulders, water on one side.

memory.fact: Moss Hollow is a dip among old pines, floored with deep moss and ringed by mossy boulders.
Moss Hollow is a dip among old pines, floored with deep moss and ringed by mossy boulders.
The pines are tall and straight, their lowest branches far above head height.
The pines are tall and straight, their lowest branches far above head height.

event: Two moons hang above the trees: a large pale one nearly full, and a small, faintly blue one.

memory.fact: Two moons hang over the hollow at night, one large and pale, one small and faintly blue.
Two moons hang over the hollow at night, one large and pale, one small and faintly blue.

event: Her breath shows in the air, and the cold comes up through the wet moss into her legs.

memory.fact: The hollow is cold at night, cold enough that breath shows in the air.
The hollow is cold at night, cold enough that breath shows in the air.

event: Far to the north a long howl rises; voice after voice joins until the whole forest sings.

memory.fact: Many voices howl together from the forest north of the hollow at night.
Many voices howl together from the forest north of the hollow at night.

event: The howling stops at last, and the silence after it is very large.
Nala says quietly to herself, in the new voice, that this is definitely not Earth.
She tries "Isekai protocol. System?" and the hollow stays exactly as it was.
She says "Status?" and faint letters appear in the air before her eyes.
【Name: Nala】 【Level: 1/10】 【Race: Human (Tier 0)】 【Gender: Female】

memory.fact: Nala's status reads Name: Nala, Level: 1/10, Race: Human (Tier 0), Gender: Female.
Nala's status reads Name: Nala, Level: 1/10, Race: Human (Tier 0), Gender: Female.
Nala's status shows Class: —, for she has none yet.
Nala's status shows Class: —, for she has none yet.
Nala's HP is 30/30, her SP 19/28 from cold and fright, and her MP 5/5.
Nala's HP is 30/30, her SP 19/28 from cold and fright, and her MP 5/5.

event: 【Strength: 3】 【Dexterity: 4】 【Vitality: 3】 【Intelligence: 9】 【Willpower: 6】

memory.fact: Nala's stats: Strength 3, Dexterity 4, Vitality 3, Intelligence 9, Willpower 6.
Nala's stats: Strength 3, Dexterity 4, Vitality 3, Intelligence 9, Willpower 6.

event: 【Charisma: 3】 【Luck: 2】 【Active Skills: none】 【Passive Skills: none】 【Traits: none】

memory.fact: Nala's Charisma is 3 and her Luck 2.
Nala's Charisma is 3 and her Luck 2.
Nala's status lists no active skills, no passive skills and no traits.
Nala's status lists no active skills, no passive skills and no traits.

event: She tries "Character Sheet?" and "Menu?"; every line holds still, the list the same length.

memory.fact: Saying Status opens Nala's status; System, Character Sheet and Menu bring nothing.
Saying Status opens Nala's status; System, Character Sheet and Menu bring nothing.

event: She stops holding the letters in mind, and they thin and are gone.

memory.fact: Nala's status letters move with her gaze and fade when she stops holding them in mind.
Nala's status letters move with her gaze and fade when she stops holding them in mind.

event: Her toes have gone numb, her tights are soaked through, and a shiver runs through her unstopping.
Nala says she has been isekai'd, and that she will follow the water to find civilization.
She gets up out of the moss and follows the stream from the hollow's east edge, downhill.

memory.fact: A cold stream runs along the hollow's east edge over flat grey stones.
A cold stream runs along the hollow's east edge over flat grey stones.

event: Just below the hollow a narrow trodden line crosses the water, its mud pocked with split prints.

memory.fact: Just below the hollow a narrow trodden line crosses the stream, its mud marked by split hoof prints.
Just below the hollow a narrow trodden line crosses the stream, its mud marked by split hoof prints.

event: There is no path; she picks her way over needles, roots, moss and loose stone, and listens.

memory.fact: The stream's banks are pine needles, roots, moss and loose stone, with no path along them.
The stream's banks are pine needles, roots, moss and loose stone, with no path along them.

event: Where the stream runs open the big moon lights it like a lamp; under the pines it is near black.

memory.fact: The great moon lights the stream brightly tonight; under the thick pines it is near black.
The great moon lights the stream brightly tonight; under the thick pines it is near black.

event: An owl calls behind her, and the pines creak high overhead in the wind.

memory.fact: An owl calls along the stream at night, and the pines creak high overhead in the wind.
An owl calls along the stream at night, and the pines creak high overhead in the wind.

event: Something small scurries off through the needles ahead, and she never sees what it was.
Needles prick her soles, roots bruise them, and loose stones turn under her small bare feet.
After what feels like an hour her soles ache at every step, a dull bruise without a cut.
The stream goes over a lip of rock in a small loud fall into a steep ravine slick with spray.

memory.fact: An hour below the hollow the stream drops down a mossy ravine in a small fall.
An hour below the hollow the stream drops down a mossy ravine in a small fall.

event: Along the ravine's west rim a narrow dry trail, pocked with split prints, runs off into the pines.

memory.fact: The ravine's sides are steep, mossy and slick with spray; a dry trail runs along its west rim.
The ravine's sides are steep, mossy and slick with spray; a dry trail runs along its west rim.

event: Nala kneels above the fall and drinks deep; the water aches in her teeth and tastes of stone.

memory.fact: The stream above the fall is ice-cold and tastes of nothing but stone.
The stream above the fall is ice-cold and tastes of nothing but stone.

event: She takes the trail along the west rim; within a few hundred paces the water is out of sight.

memory.fact: The rim trail runs a few hundred paces west of the ravine, out of sight of the water.
The rim trail runs a few hundred paces west of the ravine, out of sight of the water.

event: The roar of the fall carries through the trees on her left, and she keeps it there.

memory.fact: The fall's roar carries along the rim trail, so the water can be followed by ear.
The fall's roar carries along the rim trail, so the water can be followed by ear.

event: Something big lurches up ahead with a snort: a doe and a yearling crash away, white tails flashing.

memory.fact: A doe and her yearling bed down tonight on the rim trail, and bolt crashing if come upon.
A doe and her yearling bed down tonight on the rim trail, and bolt crashing if come upon.

event: At a boulder split in two the trail forks: right climbs on west, left drops into a stony gully.

memory.fact: The rim trail forks at a split boulder: the left fork drops down a gully to the stream.
The rim trail forks at a split boulder: the left fork drops down a gully to the stream.
The rim trail's right fork at the split boulder climbs on west, away from the water.
The rim trail's right fork at the split boulder climbs on west, away from the water.

event: She takes the left fork down, half-crouched, the stones biting her sore soles at every step.
After a quarter of an hour the gully opens onto the stream below the fall, in moonlight again.

memory.fact: The gully is steep and stony, but dry; it meets the stream below the fall in a quarter hour.
The gully is steep and stony, but dry; it meets the stream below the fall in a quarter hour.

event: Here the stream runs wider and slower under leaning alders; mud and musk smell from downstream.

memory.fact: Below the fall the stream runs wider and slower, with alders leaning out over it.
Below the fall the stream runs wider and slower, with alders leaning out over it.
A smell of churned mud and animal musk hangs over the water downstream of the fall.
A smell of churned mud and animal musk hangs over the water downstream of the fall.

event: Her wet tights are ice against her skin; she shakes all through, and her teeth knock together.
On the gully's lip two lean wolves stand black against the sky, silent, looking down at her.
One lowers its head; the other steps back into a boulder's shadow and is simply not there.

memory.fact: Tonight two lean, silent wolves watch from the gully's lip; one vanished into a boulder's shadow.
Tonight two lean, silent wolves watch from the gully's lip; one vanished into a boulder's shadow.

event: The bank below the fall is cobble and gravel; Nala picks up a smooth, fist-sized stone.

memory.fact: Below the fall the bank is cobble and gravel, with loose stones of every size at the water.
Below the fall the bank is cobble and gravel, with loose stones of every size at the water.

event: She walks on downstream, stone in her fist, watching the edge of the pines for a fallen branch.
The wolf that lowered its head slips down onto the bank behind her, keeping well out of throw.
When she stops it stops; when she walks it walks; it never comes any closer.

memory.fact: The bolder lip wolf trails her down the bank beyond a stone's throw, stopping when she stops.
The bolder lip wolf trails her down the bank beyond a stone's throw, stopping when she stops.
The bolder lip wolf trails her down the bank beyond a stone's throw, stopping when she stops.

event: Of the second wolf there is no sign at all.
After ten minutes she reaches alders where spring floods have piled driftwood against the trunks.

memory.fact: Spring floods pile driftwood against the alders: dead limbs of alder and pine, some sound.
Spring floods pile driftwood against the alders: dead limbs of alder and pine, some sound.

event: A pine limb snaps short and brittle in her hands; deeper in lies a pale alder limb, wedged fast.

memory.fact: Dead pine in the drift snaps short and brittle; old dry alder there is light but sound.
Dead pine in the drift snaps short and brittle; old dry alder there is light but sound.
Some ten minutes down, a drift pile holds a dry alder limb, wrist-thick and taller than her.
Some ten minutes down, a drift pile holds a dry alder limb, wrist-thick and taller than her.

event: She sets the stone down and works the alder limb back and forth until it comes free all at once.

memory.fact: The drift pile limb is wedged; working it free takes a few minutes' tugging, not great strength.
The drift pile limb is wedged; working it free takes a few minutes' tugging, not great strength.

event: She snaps off the side twigs; the staff is light but sound, and reaches a head above her.
She walks on with the stone and the staff thumping, and the wolf trails her the same distance back.
Every stone is a dull hurt through her bruised soles, and she shakes in the wet tights.

memory.fact: Nala's bare soles are bruised by the stones, and she shakes with cold in her wet tights.
Nala's bare soles are bruised by the stones, and she shakes with cold in her wet tights.

event: Ahead under the alders, in trampled mud and shallows, one big bristled shape and four smaller root.

memory.fact: Downstream, trampled mud and shallows under alders hold one big bristled beast and four smaller.
Downstream, trampled mud and shallows under alders hold one big bristled beast and four smaller.
Downstream, trampled mud and shallows under alders hold one big bristled beast and four smaller.

event: The big one lifts its head, snout up and working, and stands very still.
Behind her the wolf stops, looks past her toward the mud, then turns and trots back upstream.

memory.fact: At the edge of that mud the trailing wolf stopped, looked toward it, and trotted back upstream.
At the edge of that mud the trailing wolf stopped, looked toward it, and trotted back upstream.
At the edge of that mud the trailing wolf stopped, looked toward it, and trotted back upstream.

event: Nala backs away from the mud, then climbs the west slope into the pines to go round wide.

memory.fact: The west slope round the wallow is steep, root-laced and black under the pines.
The west slope round the wallow is steep, root-laced and black under the pines.

event: Under the trees it is near black; she climbs slowly, staff planted uphill, as the grunting goes on.
Down in the mud the big one huffs once, loud, and then goes quiet.
Halfway round, a wind-thrown pine lies across the slope, chest-high, its roots a wall of earth.

memory.fact: Halfway round, a wind-thrown pine lies across the slope, chest-high, its root plate a wall.
Halfway round, a wind-thrown pine lies across the slope, chest-high, its root plate a wall.

event: She sets a bare foot on a broken stub to climb over; the stub snaps, and she pitches backward.
She slides and rolls down the slope; the stone flies from her hand, but her fingers keep the staff.

memory.fact: Nala carries an alder staff a head taller than her; her river stone was lost in her fall.
Nala carries an alder staff a head taller than her; her river stone was lost in her fall.

event: She fetches up hard against a root near the foot of the slope, the mud and alders close below.
Pain everywhere at once, in her hip, an elbow and a long burning scrape down her shin. 【HP -11】

changes.note: Fall down the west slope of the wallow: HP 30 → 19

event: Below her the four small ones squeal together and scramble in behind the big one.

memory.fact: When she fell near the mud, the four small beasts squealed and scrambled in behind the big one.
When she fell near the mud, the four small beasts squealed and scrambled in behind the big one.

event: The big one huffs, clacks its teeth, and comes at her through the mud, low, heavy and fast.
It stops short a few lengths off, head down, blowing hard through its snout, teeth clacking.

memory.fact: The big beast huffed, clacked its teeth, rushed at her through the mud, and stopped short of her.
The big beast huffed, clacked its teeth, rushed at her through the mud, and stopped short of her.
The big beast huffed, clacked its teeth, rushed at her through the mud, and stopped short of her.

event: Nala gets up slowly, the staff crosswise between her and the beast; her left hip gives a hot wrench.
She backs away step by step onto open gravel bank, staff low and ready, her hip catching.

memory.fact: At the slope's foot, open gravel bank runs downstream behind one backing from the wallow.
At the slope's foot, open gravel bank runs downstream behind one backing from the wallow.
Her fall on the west slope wrenched her left hip; she limps, and it will stiffen by morning.
Her fall on the west slope wrenched her left hip; she limps, and it will stiffen by morning.

event: The beast follows a few steps, huffing and clacking its teeth, but does not rush again.
The small ones' squealing thins to grunts and stops; the big one trots back into the mud to them.

memory.fact: The sow shadows a slow retreat a few steps, clacking, then turns back once her young go quiet.
The sow shadows a slow retreat a few steps, clacking, then turns back once her young go quiet.
The sow shadows a slow retreat a few steps, clacking, then turns back once her young go quiet.

event: Below the wallow the valley narrows; birch stands pale among the alders over loud riffles.

memory.fact: Below the wallow the valley narrows; birch joins the alder, and the stream talks over riffles.
Below the wallow the valley narrows; birch joins the alder, and the stream talks over riffles.

event: Her hip hurts, her elbow throbs, and blood from the shin scrape runs sticky and cold in her tights.

memory.fact: The fall also left a bruised elbow and a long, shallow scrape down her right shin.
The fall also left a bruised elbow and a long, shallow scrape down her right shin.
Blood from the scrape on her right shin has run down inside her tights, sticky and cold.
Blood from the scrape on her right shin has run down inside her tights, sticky and cold.

event: On the drier bank under the pines, low shrubs carry small red berries, dark in the moonlight.

memory.fact: Low shrubs on the drier banks under the pines below the wallow carry small red berries.
Low shrubs on the drier banks under the pines below the wallow carry small red berries.

event: Nala crouches stiffly by the shrubs, her hip complaining, and picks one small red berry.
She looks hard at it and says Inspect, Appraise, Identify; the air around it stays empty.

memory.fact: One with no reading skill who says Inspect, Appraise or Identify gets no answer at all.
One with no reading skill who says Inspect, Appraise or Identify gets no answer at all.

event: She bites it: sharp and sour enough to pucker her mouth, faintly bitter, full of crunching seeds.
She swallows it and says Status; the letters show HP 19/30, SP 19/28 and MP 5/5.

memory.fact: Nala's status now shows HP 19/30, SP 19/28 and MP 5/5.
Nala's status now shows HP 19/30, SP 19/28 and MP 5/5.

event: Only her HP has changed; the berry is nowhere on the list, and her stomach stays quiet.

memory.fact: Eating a plain berry shows nothing on a status: no line, no effect, no remark.
Eating a plain berry shows nothing on a status: no line, no effect, no remark.

event: She lets the status go, and the letters thin and vanish.
The shrubs hang thick with clusters of the same berries; a gust goes straight through her wet shirt.

memory.fact: The shrubs below the wallow hang thick with clusters of small red berries, sharp, sour and seedy.
The shrubs below the wallow hang thick with clusters of small red berries, sharp, sour and seedy.
Nala's shirt is wet through, and the night wind down the valley cuts straight through it.
Nala's shirt is wet through, and the night wind down the valley cuts straight through it.

event: She strips a cluster and eats the whole handful, seeds and all, sour enough to ache in her jaw.
They sit small and cold in her stomach, and she is barely less empty than before.

memory.fact: A handful of the sour red berries below the wallow barely dents an empty stomach's hunger.
A handful of the sour red berries below the wallow barely dents an empty stomach's hunger.

event: Status again: every line reads exactly as it did the last time, and she lets it fade.
Her shaking has turned to hard, jerking spasms through her shoulders and jaw that will not stop.

memory.fact: Nala's shivering has turned to hard, jerking spasms through her shoulders and jaw.
Nala's shivering has turned to hard, jerking spasms through her shoulders and jaw.

event: Her fingertips are numb and white, and her thoughts come slow, as if through cold water.

memory.fact: Nala's thoughts come slow and thick with the cold, as if pushing through cold water.
Nala's thoughts come slow and thick with the cold, as if pushing through cold water.

event: She reaches for another cluster; her fingers will not close, and the berries spill into the moss.

memory.fact: Nala's fingertips are numb and white; she can barely feel her staff, and her fingers won't close.
Nala's fingertips are numb and white; she can barely feel her staff, and her fingers won't close.

event: Nala straightens on the staff and climbs the dry bank, looking for anywhere out of the wind.
She feels between black trunks with the staff, goes too far up, and loses the stream and finds it.
The north wind finds her wherever she stands, and she comes back to the cowberry shrubs.

memory.fact: The cowberry shrubs are the only low cover on the bank, and the north wind blows through them.
The cowberry shrubs are the only low cover on the bank, and the north wind blows through them.

event: She curls up tight among them on the needles, the staff beside her, and the wind comes through.
She shakes and shakes, and at some point, without knowing when, she sleeps.

memory.fact: Nala slept the night of day one curled among the cowberry shrubs, with no roof or shelter.
Nala slept the night of day one curled among the cowberry shrubs, with no roof or shelter.

event: She wakes in the dark not knowing why; far off to the north-west the wolves are howling.

memory.fact: Late in the night the wolf pack howls far off to the north-west, long and many-voiced.
Late in the night the wolf pack howls far off to the north-west, long and many-voiced.

event: She sleeps again, badly, in pieces, the cold in her bones each time she half wakes.
She opens her eyes to a grey sky: mist lies along the stream, and frost silvers bank and sleeve.

memory.fact: At first light on day two frost silvers the bank and mist lies along the stream below.
At first light on day two frost silvers the bank and mist lies along the stream below.

event: Her shirt and tights have dried on her in the night, the cloth stiff with frost outside.

memory.fact: Nala's shirt and tights dried on her overnight, the cloth stiff with frost on the outside.
Nala's shirt and tights dried on her overnight, the cloth stiff with frost on the outside.

event: Her mouth is dry, her stomach griping; she can't feel her feet, and her hands are clubs.

memory.fact: On waking on day two Nala is thirsty and hungry, her mouth dry and her stomach griping.
On waking on day two Nala is thirsty and hungry, her mouth dry and her stomach griping.
After the night Nala can't feel her feet, her hands are numb clubs, and her whole body aches.
After the night Nala can't feel her feet, her hands are numb clubs, and her whole body aches.

event: Letters are waiting: 【HP -14】 【Night survived. Barely. Most people use a roof.】

changes.note: A freezing night unroofed in wet clothes: HP 19 → 5
Fitful freezing sleep gives little back: SP 19 → 16
Growth for surviving her first night: 0 → 3

memory.fact: At dawn the System told Nala: Night survived. Barely. Most people use a roof.
At dawn the System told Nala: Night survived. Barely. Most people use a roof.
The System often adds a dry, mocking remark after a feat, a folly or a near death.

event: A wren scolds close by; Nala shouts at the sky that the System is useless and has an attitude.
A grouse whirs up from the bank grass, and letters hang before her: 【Noted. The forest is unmoved.】

memory.fact: The System answered Nala's shout: Noted. The forest is unmoved.
The System answered Nala's shout: Noted. The forest is unmoved.

event: She gets the staff under her and sets off down the stream, her hip grating at every step.
Her feet come back to her as burning, and her hands as aching.

memory.fact: Feeling returns to Nala's feet as burning and to her hands as aching.
Feeling returns to Nala's feet as burning and to her hands as aching.

event: Then the walking works on her: the hard spasms ease off, and her chest loosens.

memory.fact: As Nala walks, the hard spasms ease off and her chest loosens.
As Nala walks, the hard spasms ease off and her chest loosens.

event: The sun tops the east rim and lays full light along gravel and water; she walks into its warmth.
Deer tracks cut the mud of a bend, and a heron in a shallow pool watches her pass.

memory.fact: A heron fishes the shallows above the junction, and deer tracks cross the gravel every morning.
A heron fishes the shallows above the junction, and deer tracks cross the gravel every morning.

event: Hunger sits under her ribs like a closed fist, and her mouth is dry as cloth.
Blood shows in her footprints now; the stones have worn through one sole.

changes.note: Cut soles after four hours barefoot: HP 5 → 4
Hours of limping downstream unfed and parched: SP 16 → 4

memory.fact: Stones have worn through one of Nala's soles, and blood shows in her footprints.
Stones have worn through one of Nala's soles, and blood shows in her footprints.

event: By mid-morning the sun is high, the pines thin out, and much bigger water sounds ahead.

memory.fact: The last hours of the way run open and sunlit; gravel bars lie in the sun from mid-morning.
The last hours of the way run open and sunlit; gravel bars lie in the sun from mid-morning.

event: She comes out on a wide, slow river running west, all glitter on a gravel shore.
Dry sedge and birch bark stand along the gravel there, and both strip easily in the hand.

memory.fact: Dry sedge and birch bark strip easily on that stretch; wrapped on, they end what bare feet cost.
Dry sedge and birch bark strip easily on that stretch; wrapped on, they end what bare feet cost.

event: At the meeting of the waters stand a low smoking mound and, beside it, a turf hut.

memory.fact: The camp sits on flat gravel where the hollow stream runs into the Carrow.
The camp sits on flat gravel where the hollow stream runs into the Carrow.

event: A shaggy brown dog barks at the hut and comes down the gravel; a man at the mound calls to her.
Nala shouts back that she has been lost a night and a day, and asks a traveller's hospitality.

changes.note: Jory warms to her plain asking: -3 → -2
Wat warms to her plain asking: -3 → -2

memory.fact: Nala calls to the camp for hospitality, having been lost in the woods a night and a day.
Nala calls to the camp for hospitality, having been lost in the woods a night and a day.
Nala calls to the camp for hospitality, having been lost in the woods a night and a day.
Nala calls to the camp for hospitality, having been lost in the woods a night and a day.

event: The man at the mound answers at once in a thick Weald burr: come up, come to the fire.
The dog trots up, sniffs her tights, and leans its whole weight against her legs.

memory.fact: Burr is Wat's big shaggy hound; he barks at anything out of the woods, then wants to be petted.
Burr is Wat's big shaggy hound; he barks at anything out of the woods, then wants to be petted.

event: The younger man, near thirty and steady-faced, looks once at her bare feet and says nothing of them.
The old one, grey and hunched, shouts from the hut for her to come in by the fire.
The hut is poles and turf over a stone hearth, with two beds of fern and hides and a kettle on.

memory.fact: The hut is poles and turf, with a stone hearth, a fire kept in, and two beds of fern and hides.
The hut is poles and turf, with a stone hearth, a fire kept in, and two beds of fern and hides.

event: She sits on a hide by the hearth, shaking; the young man hands her hot tea and bread and fish.

memory.fact: Jory is a steady, quiet man of thirty, slow to speak and quick to hand a stranger a bowl.
Jory is a steady, quiet man of thirty, slow to speak and quick to hand a stranger a bowl.
The burners have bread, bacon, dried fish, tea and a kettle, and eat plain but plenty.
The burners have bread, bacon, dried fish, tea and a kettle, and eat plain but plenty.

event: The heat goes down into her chest, and the bowl is empty very quickly.

changes.note: Tea, bread and fish by the fire: SP 4 → 7

memory.fact: Guest-right: anyone who asks shelter of a roof is fed and warmed that night, no questions.
Guest-right: anyone who asks shelter of a roof is fed and warmed that night, no questions.

event: The old man has the salve pot and cloth brought for her feet: she'll not go cold in this hut.

memory.fact: Wat has the salve pot and the cloth brought for Nala's feet.
Wat has the salve pot and the cloth brought for Nala's feet.
Wat has the salve pot and the cloth brought for Nala's feet.

event: Her shaking slows, and stops, the heat on her face and her hands.

memory.fact: Fed and warmed at the burners' fire, Nala's shaking slows and stops.
Fed and warmed at the burners' fire, Nala's shaking slows and stops.

event: The dog lies down with its chin across her good foot and sighs through its nose.

memory.fact: Burr leans his weight against Nala's legs, then lies with his chin over her foot.
Burr leans his weight against Nala's legs, then lies with his chin over her foot.

event: The young man sits opposite with his own mug and asks her name, her home and what road brought her.

memory.fact: Folk ask a stranger's name, home village and road; no name and no village is a bad answer.
Folk ask a stranger's name, home village and road; no name and no village is a bad answer.
